# Host-test JSON dependency

These unmodified MIT-licensed cJSON 1.7.19 source/header/license files are from
the ESP-IDF 5.5.3 JSON submodule, commit
`c859b25da02955fef659d658b8f324b5cde87be3` of
[cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/c859b25da02955fef659d658b8f324b5cde87be3).
They let the protocol host tests compile without an installed SDK or network.
Firmware uses ESP-IDF's `json` component, not this copy. No local modifications.
